thread.title: AAP Exclusive: Apple's Stock Needs to Come Down Some Before They Add - TheStreet

author: Home
title: AAP Exclusive: Apple's Stock Needs to Come Down Some Before They Add - TheStreet
text:
In the May Action Alerts PLUS members' call, Jim Cramer answered a member's question about Apple ( AAPL ) .
The stock has been on a tear lately. It's up over 11% year-to-date and up over 26% over the last year.
And with the price of iPhones potentially dropping and those HomePod speakers finally being shipped, Cramer's AAP member wondered if he should be adding more.
More importantly, he wanted to know what the AAP team was going to do.
"Well, we've trimmed Apple to the point where we don't need to trim it any more, and maybe you should do the same," he suggested.
But watch the video above now to hear when and if they are going to add more to the AAP portfolio .
